title: De Gaulle (II): Liberté (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Part 2 : During the Second World War, General de Gaulle seeks to establish himself as the representative of the “France Libre”. He continues his political struggle, notably against General Giraud in French Africa, whilst maintaining a strained relationship with the American President,
Franklin Delano Roosevelt. In the midst of the war, the General seeks to assist the French Resistance, maintaining regular contact with Jean Moulin, right up until the Liberation of Paris.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 第二部: 第二次世界大戰期間，戴高樂將軍力圖確立自己為「自由法國」的領袖。一邊廂，他繼續在政治上抗爭，尤其在法屬非洲與吉羅將軍對抗，同時與美國的羅斯福總統關係緊張。另一邊廂，戰事期間，他設法支援法國的抵抗運動，與尚·穆蘭保持定期聯絡，直至巴黎解放。
